title: Nvidia Reaches $5.78 Trillion Market Cap in New All Time High
summary:
The chipmaker's shares reached a peak of $239.86 on Oct. 5, the highest trading price in the company's history. This intraday surge, which began from an opening price of $236.07, elevated Nvidia's market capitalization to $5.78 trillion and narrowed its gap to becoming the first company ever valued at $6 trillion.

This latest record follows a recovery that began Oct. 2, when shares hit their first all-time high since May after a two month selloff erased more than $1 trillion in market value. The rally is supported by a $150 billion increase in share buyback authorization and optimism that AI agents will drive increased demand for Nvidia hardware.
